description: Set ACL tags on a device. Replaces all existing tags — pass the full list of tags you want applied.

deviceId.description: The device ID. nodeId from tailscale_list_devices (e.g. nPM2KNuedB21DEVEL); numeric id ok; not the nodeKey.

tags.description: Full list of ACL tags (e.g. ['tag:server', 'tag:production']). Replaces all existing tags.

name: tailscale_set_device_tags
title: Set device tags
